description: Core risk/return tearsheet from a single return series: annualized return (compounded, not linear) and volatility, Sharpe (plain + Lo 2002-corrected + Pezier-White skew/kurtosis-adjusted), Sortino, max drawdown, Calmar ratio, the drawdown-ratio cluster (Ulcer Index/Martin ratio, Pain Index/Pain ratio, Burke ratio + modified), Omega-Sharpe ratio, Upside Potential Ratio, skewness, kurtosis, Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio, win rate, best/worst single-period return. Edge cases: at least 3 returns; periods_per_year 1 to 100,000,000 (default 365); mar (minimum acceptable return per period) and benchmark_sharpe default 0; a series with no drawdown makes Calmar an error, a series with no period below mar makes Sortino an error, and a flat series is an error. Not covered: a benchmark return series (alpha, beta, tracking error), fees, taxes, leverage and intraperiod drawdown. Use when user asks for a full risk summary/report on a strategy or portfolio's returns, not just one metric. Returns all of the above in one call. Returns are decimals (0.02 is 2%), at least 3 periods; the call returns an error when the series never draws down (Calmar undefined) or no period falls below mar (Sortino undefined).

benchmark_sharpe.description: Benchmark Sharpe ratio for the PSR figure, same periodicity as returns (default 0)

mar.description: Minimum acceptable return for the Sortino ratio, same periodicity as returns (default 0)

periods_per_year.description: Periods per year for annualization (default 365). Any number from 1 to 100 million, e.g. 365.25.

returns.description: Return series, one value per period
